items.c: This bone core is from a 34-year-old male who presented after noticing a swelling over two years ago. The diagnosis of follicular lymphoma was made at another institution, but he was referred here for staging and treatment. This is an excellent example of the characteristic paratrabecular infiltrate of follicular lymphoma when it involves the bone marrow. More often, the involvement is subtle and easy to overlook. Flow cytometry came back showing B-cell markers and CD10 on the tumor cells.
